description: Implement the constructor of a Transaction class. It must store the given transaction id and amount on the instance, so that they are accessible afterwards as transaction.transaction_id and transaction.amount.
test_code:
import pytest
from main import Transaction

test_cases = [
    ("tx_001", 100),
    ("tx_002", 0),
    ("tx_003", 4550),
]

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input1", "input2"), test_cases
)
def test_transaction_init(input1, input2):
    print("\n---------------------------------")
    print(f"Inputs: {input1}, {input2}")
    transaction = Transaction(input1, input2)
    print(f"Expected: transaction_id={input1}, amount={input2}")
    print(f"Actual:   transaction_id={transaction.transaction_id}, amount={transaction.amount}")
    assert transaction.transaction_id == input1
    assert transaction.amount == input2
